name: TACO-Play: Robot Play and Visual Affordance Dataset
description: TACO-Play (Task-Agnostic Continuous Offline Play) is an open-source robotic manipulation dataset designed to study visual affordance grounding and language-guided imitation learning from unstructured human play data. Recorded by University of Freiburg researchers, the dataset captures a Franka Emika Panda robot arm interacting with modular tabletop kitchen setups (including cabinet doors, drawers, sliding panels, and cooking props). The dataset contains 3,603 demonstration episodes (3,242 training and 361 testing) with synchronized multi-view RGB-D video, proprioceptive joint states, Cartesian actions, and natural language instruction annotations. TACO-Play is also incorporated as a constituent dataset in the Open X-Embodiment consortium.
